title: Compact Field ID final cross-rank coverage, comparisons, evidence and links
requested_scope: Make sure no key species/family/genus ID information is missing in the Field ID interface before moving on.
findings_fixed: Family recognition/diagnostic content was not displayed from canonical family.json; now loads on drilldown.
Genus recognition cues were not displayed from canonical genus.json; now loads.
Searching from Family/Genus rank could not find a plant by common name; now can.
Field ID omitted rich lookalike matrices and local comparison distinctions; now rendered in optional expandable sections.
Field ID omitted many existing certainty and what-to-photograph guardrails; now displayed.
Original detail gallery stopped after 10 photos; now allows first 36 with honest count and a full species lesson link.
Species full-Learner link led to homepage; now links directly to target species via verified manifest ID.
Arrays of structured morphological objects could display as [object Object]; now only safe readable text is displayed.
Photo-gap/provisional status and remaining diagnostic photo targets were hidden; now flagged.
Safe paths with valid Unicode filenames no longer silently excluded; retain traversal protections.
Family.json four-segment path was initially rejected during revised path-safety audit; corrected and retested.
science_preservation: Original canonical species, genus, family, image-credit and taxonomic data unchanged, including every HOLD/PHOTO_GAPS and provisional flag. New UI only.
tests: JavaScript syntax for Field ID and Learner
Schizachyrium scoparium vs KR bluestem rich comparison
Unfinished photographic evidence warning and specific gap list
Existing publishing photo-rights gate remains active
Quiz and advanced Field ID unchanged
remaining_nonblocking: Species-by-species photographic review and difficult botanical identifications remain ongoing; audit does not claim every plant is 100% photo-complete or scientifically final. User can continue viewing annotated source photo arrows for correction.
publish: GitHub Pages rights-filtered workflow with existing QA and privacy restrictions must succeed.
